whatdo_card_1: Design and development of electronic equipment for different industries applying DFM (Design for Manufacturing).

whatdo_card_3: Development of relational database systems and resolution of SQL queries across standards and SQL formats.
whatdo_card_4: Development of specialized systems for data center management.
whatdo_card_5: For development, we use modern technologies such as C, HTML, DHTML, and JavaScript, and we create new concepts based on them.
whatdo_card_6: Development of graphic environments that include modern interfaces with voice control and search systems; we create API connections for integration with multiple external systems and processes.
whatdo_card_7: We develop new methodologies and expertise in the IT field to create cutting-edge products based on "Blockchain" and "Only-WEB" technologies.
whatdo_card_8: Development of custom embedded software and user/server interfaces.
whatdo_card_9: Our professionals use C++, PHP, Python, Assembler, SQL, and other programming and query languages.
whatdo_card_10: Local and continuous technical support and maintenance.
whatdo_card_11: We develop applications for different operating systems: Windows, Linux, Android, iOS, FreeBSD UNIX.
whatdo_card_12: We create server systems using UNIX platforms, including full creation and installation of Firewall, DNS servers, WEB servers, FTP servers, Mail servers, SMS servers, and Voice servers.
whatdo_card_13: We work with systems and protocols such as RDP, SSH, OSP, and JumpServer, synchronizing processes with the SWIFT system.
whatdo_card_14: Development of banking systems and "Transaction-CORE", plus API services for banking tasks (acquiring connections, client work systems, process automation, and synchronization of external and internal processes, etc.).
whatdo_card_15: Developments in AI and voice technology.
whatdo_card_16: Integration of digital solutions with operational processes to scale businesses safely and measurably.
